conbody.p: With the vehicle is in DRIVE READY, select SettingsVehicleDriver assistanceBlind-spot safety on the infotainment system.

li.p: Blind-spot safety: Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist will warn and braking assist will be applied depending on the collision risk levels.
The following warning message will appear on the LCD display.

For more details, refer to the warning and control section of the function.
Blind spot safety system is Off

conbody.p: When activating Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist or restarting the vehicle with this function activated, the warning light on the outside rearview mirror will appear for approximately 3 seconds.
When the vehicle is restarted with Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist inactivated, the warning message will appear on the cluster.

note.p: If Blind-Spot Safety is deselected, the driver cannot get help from Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist. Always drive with care.

When the trailer’s connector is plugged into your vehicle, Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist automatically turns off. In this case, you cannot get help from Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist. Pay extra attention when you drive when the function is inactive. (If a Kia genuine Trailer Kit that can determine whether a trailer is connected is used)
If the vehicle is turned off and restarted, Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist will maintain the last setting.
